mentions.name: SimilaritiesEngine
mentions.description: A music recommender website oriented towards albums. Users enter their five favorite albums and immediately receive a list of suggested albums. It is free to use with no sign-up and integrates with Spotify so users can hear immediate samples or play the whole album.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A music recommender website oriented towards albums.

Tell it your 5 favorite albums, get an immediate suggestions list. No sign up, free to use, integrated with Spotify to hear immediate samples (or the whole album).
